summary: Task 2 (PropManage Basic 9€ commercial flow) — end-to-end tested. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed on new /app/backend/tests/test_pricing_basic_iter184.py covering plan existence, checkout-session (basic slug + unknown 404), checkout-status (valid + 404), simulated activation via hh_subscriptions upsert triggering CLIENT_BASIC tier + house_health_basic feature, dashboard no longer locked=no_subscription after activation, and regression on client@ (CLIENT_PREMIUM, bypass=false) + admin@ (CLIENT_PREMIUM, bypass=true) + unauthenticated checkout (401). Frontend: /pricing renders publicly (unauth) with all required data-testids, FREE marked as current for anonymous visitor, CTA click while unauth → /login?next=/pricing, premium user sees 'Ai deja acces · PropManage Premium' badge and CTA hidden. Backend integration with Stripe checkout returns real cs_test_... session ID + checkout.stripe.com URL.
critical_code_review_comments: PricingPage.jsx clears entitlement cache BEFORE Stripe redirect and useEffect refresh on session_id return — good UX. Consistent with HouseHealthUpgradePage success handler which also calls clearEntitlementCache().
PricingPage treats CLIENT_PRO / CLIENT_PREMIUM as 'already basic' via isBasic array — correct (higher tiers implicitly include basic).
Register endpoint uses field name `terms_accepted` (not `accept_terms` as noted in review request context) — informative for any future test writer.
hh_subscriptions.expires_at is compared as ISO string (not BSON date) in entitlements._fetch_active_subscription — any manual DB seed must use ISO string, not datetime object.
test_credentials: client@propmanage.io / Client123! (premium), admin@propmanage.io / 1!nasov01ADMIN. FREE users created dynamically as free{ts}{hex}@example.com / FreePass123! and cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Fresh FREE user created via /api/auth/register (with terms_accepted=true, privacy_policy_accepted=true) during pytest fixture 'free_user'. hh_subscriptions doc upserted directly in Mongo to simulate paid activation. All test-created data cleaned in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register API expects `terms_accepted` (not accept_terms). Users have MongoDB _id serialized as `id` via serialize_doc — hh_subscriptions.user_id = str(user._id). Entitlements query compares expires_at as ISO string — never use datetime objects when seeding hh_subscriptions manually.
rca of the issue: No production issues. Two test-setup issues encountered and fixed during test authoring: (1) register field name mismatch accept_terms→terms_accepted, (2) hh_subscriptions.expires_at must be ISO string for entitlements query to match.
